summary: Show browser-to-Controller ISO upload progress on Storage (upload form and ISO library) using the same meter Tasks already shows. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Create-VM guide now says upload progress appears on Storage as well as Tasks.

api.reason: Presentation of existing in-browser upload state only; no Controller or Core API change.

roadmap.reason: Console QoL for an existing transfer; no phase gate moves.

state.reason: Upload progress is ephemeral browser session state owned by the Controller shell UI, not durable pool or Controller inventory.

verification.method: node web/src/managed.test.mjs; npm --prefix web run typecheck; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Live browser upload not exercised in this change.
